interface.longDescription: cc-nexs runs a low-token Lean workflow with an independent plan review, two human gates, per-repository worktrees, deterministic local verification, one consolidated Review, test verification, configurable per-role models, and approved base integration. Standalone hotfix repairs share the same delivery controls.
